meanings.en: to manage to live or survive with limited resources
meanings.exampleEn: They get by on a very small income.

meanings.en: a period of difficulty or distress
meanings.exampleEn: She had a hard time adjusting to her new school.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni okuluna uyum sağlamakta zor bir dönem geçirdi.

meanings.en: in summary; to put it briefly
meanings.exampleEn: In short, the project was a complete success.

meanings.en: no longer current or useful; obsolete
meanings.exampleEn: The factory still uses outdated equipment.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika hâlâ modası geçmiş ekipman kullanıyor.

meanings.en: lacking knowledge or information about something
meanings.exampleEn: It was an uninformed decision based on rumors.

meanings.en: to increase the size, amount, or extent of something
meanings.exampleEn: The company plans to scale up production next year.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket gelecek yıl üretimi büyütmeyi planlıyor.

meanings.en: something that fails to work or is useless
meanings.exampleEn: The new phone turned out to be a dud.

meanings.en: planning for the future; progressive
meanings.exampleEn: The company has a forward-thinking approach to technology.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketin teknolojiye karşı ileri görüşlü bir yaklaşımı var.

meanings.en: easily broken or damaged
meanings.exampleEn: The vase is very fragile, so handle it carefully.
meanings.exampleTr: Vazo çok kırılgan, bu yüzden dikkatli tut.

meanings.en: unable to bend; not flexible
meanings.exampleEn: The school has rigid rules about uniforms.
meanings.exampleTr: Okulun üniformalar konusunda katı kuralları var.

meanings.en: having a wide range of skills or abilities
meanings.exampleEn: She is an all-round athlete who excels in many sports.
meanings.exampleTr: O, birçok sporda başarılı, çok yönlü bir sporcu.

meanings.en: very skilled or proficient at something
meanings.exampleEn: He is adept at solving complex problems.

meanings.en: lacking the skill or ability to do something well

meanings.exampleTr: Beceriksiz yönetici birkaç maliyetli hata yaptı.

meanings.en: putting a lot of effort into work
meanings.exampleEn: She is a hardworking student who never gives up.
meanings.exampleTr: O, asla pes etmeyen çalışkan bir öğrenci.

meanings.en: failing to take proper care of something
meanings.exampleEn: The negligent driver caused the accident.

meanings.en: highly motivated to achieve goals
meanings.exampleEn: She is a driven person who always aims for the top.
meanings.exampleTr: O, her zaman zirveyi hedefleyen azimli biri.

meanings.exampleEn: The workshop is designed for aspiring writers.
meanings.exampleTr: Atölye, yazar olmaya hevesli kişiler için tasarlandı.

meanings.en: having little desire to succeed or achieve
meanings.exampleEn: He was criticized for being unambitious in his career.

meanings.en: showing no interest, enthusiasm, or concern
meanings.exampleEn: The students seemed apathetic about the new project.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenciler yeni proje konusunda ilgisiz görünüyordu.

meanings.en: in a way that responds to events rather than planning ahead
meanings.exampleEn: The team tends to work reactively instead of planning ahead.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekip önceden plan yapmak yerine tepkisel olarak çalışma eğiliminde.

meanings.en: lacking coherence or logical connection
meanings.exampleEn: His speech was disjointed and hard to follow.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşması kopuktu ve takip etmesi zordu.

meanings.en: strong and not easily damaged
meanings.exampleEn: The table is made of sturdy oak.

meanings.en: done gradually or in separate stages rather than all at once
meanings.exampleEn: The reforms were introduced in a piecemeal fashion.
meanings.exampleTr: Reformlar parça parça bir şekilde uygulandı.

meanings.en: guided by ideals rather than practical considerations
meanings.exampleEn: As a young teacher, she was very idealistic.
meanings.exampleTr: Genç bir öğretmen olarak çok idealistti.

meanings.en: acting without thinking about the consequences
meanings.exampleEn: His reckless driving put everyone at risk.

meanings.en: providing satisfaction or worthwhile benefit
meanings.exampleEn: Teaching can be a very rewarding career.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmenlik çok tatmin edici bir meslek olabilir.

meanings.en: not making a profit or financial gain
meanings.exampleEn: They closed the unprofitable branch last year.

meanings.en: to move or guide skillfully and carefully
meanings.exampleEn: She maneuvered the car into the tight parking space.
meanings.exampleTr: Arabayı dar park yerine ustaca manevra yaparak soktu.

meanings.en: the condition of being more important and dealt with first
meanings.exampleEn: Safety takes precedence over speed in this factory.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu fabrikada güvenlik hıza göre önceliğe sahiptir.

meanings.en: to perform or complete a task or plan
meanings.exampleEn: The scientists will carry out the experiment tomorrow.

meanings.en: a sign or measurement that shows the state of something
meanings.exampleEn: Unemployment is a key indicator of economic health.
meanings.exampleTr: İşsizlik, ekonomik sağlığın önemli bir göstergesidir.

meanings.en: a gradual increase or accumulation of something
meanings.exampleEn: There was a slow buildup of pressure in the pipe.
meanings.exampleTr: Boruda yavaş bir basınç birikimi vardı.

meanings.en: an obstruction that stops movement or flow

meanings.exampleTr: Borudaki bir tıkanıklık su baskınına neden oldu.

meanings.en: a limitation or restriction on what can be done

meanings.exampleTr: Bütçe kısıtlamaları onları projeyi iptal etmeye zorladı.

meanings.en: the quality of being honest and not secretive

meanings.en: the quality of being clear and easy to understand
meanings.exampleEn: The report was praised for its clarity.

meanings.en: the state of keeping things hidden or private
meanings.exampleEn: The negotiations were conducted in complete secrecy.
meanings.exampleTr: Müzakereler tam bir gizlilik içinde yürütüldü.

meanings.en: the quality of being reliable and deserving of trust
meanings.exampleEn: Her trustworthiness made her the ideal candidate.

meanings.en: at the correct or expected time; not late
meanings.exampleEn: The train arrived exactly on time.

meanings.en: distant or reserved in manner; not friendly
meanings.exampleEn: He remained aloof during the entire party.

meanings.en: having a powerful attraction or charm
meanings.exampleEn: The speaker had a magnetic personality that drew the crowd.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşmacının kalabalığı kendine çeken etkileyici bir kişiliği vardı.

meanings.en: modest and not seeking attention
meanings.exampleEn: Despite his fame, he is remarkably unassuming.

meanings.en: excessively proud of oneself
meanings.exampleEn: He was too conceited to admit his mistake.
meanings.exampleTr: Hatasını kabul etmeyecek kadar kendini beğenmişti.

meanings.en: arrogantly superior and disdainful
meanings.exampleEn: She gave him a haughty look and walked away.
meanings.exampleTr: Ona kibirli bir bakış attı ve uzaklaştı.

meanings.en: sincere and deeply felt
meanings.exampleEn: She offered her heartfelt thanks to the volunteers.

meanings.en: not expressing genuine feelings; false
meanings.exampleEn: His apology sounded insincere.

meanings.en: genuine and real; not a copy
meanings.exampleEn: The museum displays authentic Roman artifacts.

meanings.en: not able to be relied upon or trusted
meanings.exampleEn: He proved to be an untrustworthy business partner.
meanings.exampleTr: Güvenilmez bir iş ortağı olduğu ortaya çıktı.

meanings.en: not faithful or loyal to a person or cause
meanings.exampleEn: He was accused of being disloyal to his friends.

meanings.en: not thinking about the feelings or needs of others
meanings.exampleEn: It was inconsiderate of him to play loud music at night.
meanings.exampleTr: Gece yüksek sesle müzik çalması düşüncesizceydi.

meanings.en: not providing help or encouragement
meanings.exampleEn: Her unsupportive family discouraged her dreams.

meanings.en: to make someone lose interest or enthusiasm
meanings.exampleEn: Constant criticism can demotivate employees.

meanings.en: to join with another to work together
meanings.exampleEn: The two companies teamed up to launch a new product.
meanings.exampleTr: İki şirket yeni bir ürün çıkarmak için birlikte çalıştı.

meanings.en: to block or hinder progress or movement
meanings.exampleEn: The fallen tree obstructed the road.

meanings.en: equal in value, amount, or meaning
meanings.exampleEn: One dollar is roughly equivalent to thirty Turkish lira.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir dolar kabaca otuz Türk lirasına eşdeğerdir.

meanings.en: polite ways of behaving in society
meanings.exampleEn: Children should be taught good manners.

meanings.en: the official rules of correct or proper conduct
meanings.exampleEn: Diplomatic protocol requires formal attire.

meanings.en: the feeling of being grateful
meanings.exampleEn: She expressed her thankfulness for their support.

meanings.en: a lack of gratitude or appreciation
meanings.exampleEn: He was hurt by his son's ingratitude.

meanings.en: to apologize for a mistake or wrongdoing
meanings.exampleEn: You should say sorry when you hurt someone.

meanings.en: to make secret or private information known
meanings.exampleEn: She refused to divulge the source of the leak.

meanings.en: officially secret and restricted in access
meanings.exampleEn: The documents were marked as classified.

meanings.en: the art of public speaking, especially eloquently
meanings.exampleEn: His powerful oratory moved the entire audience.

meanings.en: formal discussions or negotiations
meanings.exampleEn: The peace talks lasted for several weeks.

meanings.en: a long speech by one person
meanings.exampleEn: The actor delivered a moving monologue.

meanings.en: the state of being unable to pay one's debts
meanings.exampleEn: The firm was driven into insolvency by the crisis.

meanings.en: the act of providing money for a project or purpose
meanings.exampleEn: They secured financing for the new factory.

meanings.en: the act of hiding something or keeping it secret
meanings.exampleEn: The concealment of the evidence was a serious crime.

meanings.en: to be greater or better than something
meanings.exampleEn: This year's sales surpassed all expectations.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu yılın satışları tüm beklentileri aştı.

meanings.en: to fall behind or move more slowly than others
meanings.exampleEn: Sales began to lag behind those of competitors.
